scenes.title: Bellweather Glasshouse
scenes.description: The humid central conservatory glitters with rain and broken display panes. The orchid pedestal stands empty beneath blackened lamps while the household waits among palms, misted glass, and carefully arranged shock.

placements.lighting: warm amber light from the twin central lamps and left wall sconce, mixed with cool blue rainy backlight from the glasshouse windows
placements.perspective: straight-on pixel-art room view with a slightly elevated camera; floor tiles recede toward the rear glass wall and verticals remain upright
placements.reason: This spot leaves the player spawn area clear, keeps her feet on visible floor, and places the heir near the orchid display without covering the pedestal or the glass clue.

placements.lighting: warm amber spill from the left wall lantern with cooler blue reflections from the rain-dark glass behind the plants

placements.reason: The gardener belongs near the plants and service side of the conservatory, with her feet on unobstructed floor and away from the player spawn points.

scenes.title: The Mineral Pump Room
scenes.description: Under painted ironwork and steaming mineral taps, Veyrbridge society murmurs over the scandal. Dealer's cards, charity hampers, and wet footprints turn polite gossip into a map of who moved where before midnight.

placements.surface: open wet stone tile floor in the left foreground, clear of the player spawn points
placements.lighting: warm golden light from the tall left windows with softer amber gas-lamp highlights and cooler shadows toward the right
placements.perspective: straight-on room view with a shallow three-quarter tiled floor; foreground figures are larger and lower, background fixtures recede upward
placements.reason: The left foreground has visible walkable tile space beside the water counter and footprints, giving the botanist a clear standing position without blocking the clue table or exits.

placements.surface: visible stone tile aisle just left of center, in front of the potted fern and away from the investigator spawn
placements.lighting: warm side light from the left windows with dim teal shadows under the ironwork and reflected highlights on wet tiles
placements.perspective: straight-on room view with shallow three-quarter floor perspective; this mid-floor position is slightly smaller than foreground scale
placements.reason: This open aisle leaves the player spawn clear while placing the rare plant dealer near the public pump-room floor and away from the foreground table clues.

placements.surface: visible iron stair landing on the right side above the hamper area
placements.lighting: dim upper-right interior light with warm lamp glints on the railing and softer shadow than the sunlit left side
placements.perspective: elevated rear placement on the staircase, so the figure is smaller and higher in the frame than floor-level characters
placements.reason: The stair landing is a distinct visible standing surface that keeps the reverend out of the crowded hamper clue area while giving him a watchful position above the room.

clueZones.reason: The box encloses the folded written paper on the round table with the small saucer sitting over its upper edge; the visible lines of text match the debt-telegram placement described.

scenes.title: Professor Marrow's Study
scenes.description: Marrow's desk is a storm of field notes, specimen drawers, coded plant labels, and disturbed correspondence. The missing journal has left shapes behind: impressions, dust lines, and appointments no one is eager to explain.

placements.surface: visible wooden floor just left of the right-hand rug and beside the front of Marrow's desk
placements.lighting: dim study lighting with warm amber highlights from the left wall sconce and green desk lamp, with cooler rain-blue fill from the window
placements.perspective: slightly elevated three-quarter side view; floor recedes diagonally toward the rear wall and furniture tops are visible
placements.reason: This spot places Livia on unobstructed floor near the inheritance papers and desk, away from the player spawn points and clear of the door transition.

placements.surface: visible parquet floor in front of the left specimen drawers and bookcase
placements.lighting: dim study lighting with stronger warm glow from the left sconce and window-side instruments, fading into the central desk lamp light
placements.perspective: slightly elevated three-quarter side view matching the desk and floor grid, with feet planted on the visible floor plane
placements.reason: This location gives Cassian a clear standing position on the left side of the study near the botanical shelves, without blocking clue areas or spawn points.

scenes.title: The Old Orchid House Cellar
scenes.description: Beneath the estate, a disused growing chamber breathes cold mineral damp. Fresh scrapes cut through settled dust near the service hatch, and something has been hidden behind cracked propagation frames.

placements.surface: visible tiled floor in front of the right-side potted orchids and cellar window
placements.lighting: dim mixed cellar light, with cool green window light from the right and weaker warm lantern spill from the upper left
placements.perspective: side-on pixel-art cellar view with a shallow top-down floor plane receding toward the back wall
placements.reason: The open floor in front of the right plant grouping is unobstructed, keeps Marta near the greenhouse collection she tends, and does not cover either clue region or the player spawn points.

placements.surface: visible central tiled floor in front of the dusty propagation frames
placements.lighting: low amber-green cellar lighting, mostly shadowed with faint warm spill from the left lantern and cool reflected light from the right window
placements.perspective: side-on pixel-art cellar view with a shallow top-down floor plane receding toward the back wall
placements.reason: This central floor position places Silas near the hidden-crate area without overlapping the actual clue, and leaves the investigator spawn area clear.

placements.surface: visible tiled floor just left of the leaning cracked propagation frames
